name: Card back
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Style reference only. One tarot CARD BACK, NO face scene. An elegant William Morris-style symmetrical botanical repeat of oak, acanthus and acacia, forest green, warm ivory, madder red and ochre. A central eight-pointed star medallion with two opposing pairs of drawing compasses and set squares woven subtly into the foliage. Fine woodcut contours, flat matte printed color, restrained geometric border. Precisely 180-degree rotational symmetry: turning the card upside down must look identical. No letters, G, numerals, title cartouche, signature or person. Flat portrait 3:5, whole artwork, highest available resolution. Match the reference's printmaking and botanical border.
